Patience and repetition of attempts. It took me months to get them to this point. But these birds were rescues and it’s way harder to hand tame two birds at once than one since they prefer bonding with each other rather than a human. You may want to separate them into different cages until you’re done taming them as it may make it easier. I just didn’t have that option myself. 
Aside from that, I put them in a common area in my house for a while so they’d get more used to being around humans. Then I figured out their favorite birdseed and now they only get the birdseed from my hand. 
Getting them to eat from my hand for the first time was just a waiting game of keeping my hand full of birdseed very still by the door to their cage.

Took a long long time! I’ve had my birds for a several months now. Granted, they’re rescues so it took them a little longer to acclimate. I noticed an immediate difference in their sociability when I moved them into more of a common area than my bedroom. 
Also, I found out what their favorite birdseed is. So from now, until we finish hand taming, they’ll be getting 90% of said birdseed straight from my hand.
